Method of Attack: Imitating phone calls for financial organizations to fool bankers into giving credit card details
Distributed via fake banking apps impersonating large financial institutions
Initiates phone calls playing recordings from real bank customer support
Masks called number to display impersonated bank's real number
Tricks victims into confirming credit card details
Captures live audio and video streams from compromised device
Evasion techniques including multi-disk ZIP header manipulation, AndroidManifest.xml tampering, and nested directories with long file paths
Date of Discovery: Reported by Kaspersky a year ago from article date
Recent versions reported by Check Point researchers
Indicators of Compromise: Manipulated APK files with multi-disk ZIP headers
APK asset folder with nested directories and long file paths
